weakest_link: Idea 1's Home buries the latest release. It is a 56 px chip, and on a phone the Releases section starts at 1541 px, about 1.8 screens down. The doors repeat the header nav, so the first screen is a second menu, not "label statement plus latest releases".
flip_test: Load Idea 1 at 360 px and check whether the first screen shows the statement and the newest release (cover, title, a link to its tracklist and listen links). If a grader holds that Home must visibly feature the latest release, and the chip fails that, Idea 2 leads. That holds if its dead player can be dropped without loss, which is a one-line fix and lighter than restructuring Idea 1's hero. If the chip is a clear, labelled link to the full release, Idea 1 holds.
